requirements.description: Remove the separate _is_plottable attribute from ExtensionDtype.
Make _get_plot_converter's own return value indicate "not plottable" (here an empty list) instead of relying on the flag.

label.evidence: pandas/core/dtypes/base.py after code: _is_plottable attribute and docstring entry removed; _get_plot_converter (from line 477) returns [] by default and documents "empty list = not plottable"
label.notes: Reviewer asked (as a question) whether _is_plottable is needed if _get_plot_converter signals non-plottability; the author agreed and implemented it (2bd6cb4). In base.py _is_plottable is removed and _get_plot_converter now returns [] by default. The sentinel is [] rather than the None the reviewer hypothesized. Other changes in the diff (GH#46093 name checks, docstring sections) are unrelated.
